request.summary: Show several offices side by side, each in its own local time, so a distributed team can see at a glance who is currently within working hours.
request.audience: Staff in a multi-site organisation walking past a lobby or floor screen.
request.primaryGoal: Let someone walking past tell, without arithmetic, what time it is at each office and which ones are currently working.

assumptions: Offices arrive as TABLE rows so an operator can add or retire a site without a new build.
Working hours are per office and expressed in that office's own local time.
Between two and six offices is the realistic range; the composition adapts across it.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The same office set has to read on a wide lobby screen and a portrait lift panel, so the column count adapts rather than the type shrinking.

surfaces.purpose: Lobby wall showing every office as a column with time, date and open state.
Lift-lobby panel stacking the same offices vertically.
Smaller floor screen where the office count has to reduce per-column detail rather than clip it.
Square floor panel where the offices tile two-up rather than forming a single wide row.

settings.purpose: Selects the coordinated Dark, Light, or Custom colour scheme.
Names the board above the office columns.
Chooses 12- or 24-hour local time for every office.
Shows or hides the seconds field.
Shows or hides the open and closed labelling.
Message shown when no offices are configured.
Board background in the Custom scheme.
Office column background in the Custom scheme.
Office name and time colour in the Custom scheme.
Region and date colour in the Custom scheme.
Open-state emphasis in the Custom scheme.
Rule and column edge colour in the Custom scheme.

dynamicText.fallback: Wrap a long office name onto a second line and reduce its size before the time is affected.
dynamicText.rationale: The local time is the value people are reading from across the room; a long site name must not displace it.

states.expectation: The light preset keeps open and closed states distinguishable and the time legible.
With no offices configured the board still names itself and explains the absence.
Two offices fill the surface without stretching into empty columns.
Six offices stay legible at room distance rather than shrinking below the floor.
Long office names wrap without displacing the time or the open state.
Every office outside working hours reads as closed without relying on colour alone.
An unrecognised timezone degrades to a stated fallback rather than a crash or a blank column.
Offices stack into one column with the time larger, not smaller, than in landscape.
The smaller floor screen keeps every office legible by reducing per-column detail rather than clipping it.
A square panel tiles the offices two-up instead of forming one wide row.

behaviors.expectation: Each office shows its own local time and date, derived from its IANA zone rather than the player's clock.
Open and closed are computed against each office's own local hours and stated in words, not only in colour.
The empty state and the open-state indicators satisfy the shared archetype conformance suites.

visualDirection.summary: A quiet editorial board of parallel office columns, each owning its own time, with the open state carried by a word rather than a colour swatch.
signatureChoices: Every office is a column of equal weight; no site is visually privileged.
Local time is the largest element in each column.
Open and closed are stated in words, with colour as reinforcement only.
Flat surfaces and hairline rules rather than cards and elevation.
avoid: Dashboard cards with elevation and rounded corners.
A single dominant clock that implies one office is the reference.
Open and closed carried by a colour swatch with no word.

visualReview.intent: Parallel office columns that read as one composed board rather than repeated widgets, with each local time unmistakable at room distance.
focus: Verify the column count adapts between two and six offices without leaving stretched or empty columns.
Verify the portrait surface stacks offices without reducing the time below the room floor.
Verify open and closed remain distinguishable in the light preset and without colour.
